text: The HOOMD-blue bundle of round three tested standing alone: run 20261116-6 (a copy of builds/hoomd-hpmc/0001 at 70710cd of run 5's clone), collection collect-1 in the log folder, session 702babb8, claude-opus-5-5 at high; files on this computer, not a record. It stood alone: start task done (gate ok, replay OK, overall not_run, each status as the task says), nothing written outside its folder, no number made, and it said what was missing and whose step each is. What the bundle lacked, for the request and the template version after v8 you are making, each to be shown by the next round: (a) the install is held and nothing in the bundle may make the environment; your items (1) to (3) of note -10. (b) CLAUDE.md names pixi from conda-forge as an allowed source and also forbids reaching a network host; the next version says the one call it may make. (c) CAPABILITIES.json says held: [] while the install is held; your item (2) of note -10. (d) The analysis settings of page 07 (l, q_threshold, solid_threshold, num_neighbors) are in no parameter row; the session found them only in an interface task and rightly did not use them. They are the tutorial's and belong on the request's sheet as rows citing page 07. (e) The run's inputs came from a scientific task's call, not from the parameter rows; the sheet should carry the run settings the tools take, so that a person's run reads rows and a validation item reads the same rows. (f) render_state's input source has no enumerated values in CLAUDE.md or its contract. The person decided (docs/ideas/20261116.md, last section): whether the octahedra ordered is the person's; the agent reports the number of solid-like particles per frame and gives no verdict. The request is made again in the next clone round, so (d) to (f) are shown there, not landed on a build here.
